metadata.description: Minix (riscv64gc), position-independent: shared objects and PIC code. Deliberately no --image-base, unlike the built-in target: a shared object is mapped by the loader at a base it chooses, so a link-time base is not just unnecessary but harmful — the loader maps at `slot + p_vaddr`, and the slot it reserved would then be short by the object's own base. The code model and the ABI name are the fork's `riscv64gc_unknown_minix` spec's: `medium` because the port's images sit well past medlow's reach, `lp64d` because lld refuses to link objects whose float ABI differs.
